article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Sept 13, 2022 (BSS) - Bangladesh-built 6100 DWT, a high-speed multi-

purpose container ship, has completed its technical handover export process

to the United Kingdom buyer "Enzian Shipping Company Ltd."

The ship has a built-in Ananda Shipyard located at Meghna Ghat of Sonargaon

Upazila of Narayanganj, said a press release.

The handing-over ceremony was held today in the Inter-Continental hotel

graced by the State Minister for Shipping Khalid Mahmud Chowdhury as the

chief guest.

T
